extractionMethod.value: pdftotext -layout GS-2026-0005_Gutschrift.pdf followed by manual verification of the DATEV booking text.
notes: PDF downloaded from the Telegram runtime store via recover-telegram-attachments before extraction.
Text was parsed from the body and booking proposal segments; amounts were cross-checked with the numeric summary at the bottom.
Apply this credit to reverse part of invoice RE-2026-0023 (KD-00182) using the provided SKR03 entry lines.
Verify that the net 550,00 EUR reduction and the associated 19% VAT are captured in the May 2026 posting batch before closing DAT-127.
Treat GS-2026-0005 as completed once the adjusted customer balance (10182) reflects the 654,50 EUR credit.
